stories.title: Election Integrity or Election Theft? Trump Orders DOJ to Sue Over Alaska Senate Race Before Votes Are Counted
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Moves to Stop Alaska's Shady Ballot Scheme Before Democrats Can Steal a Senate Seat
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Admits He Ordered DOJ to Sue to Block an Election Result He Hasn't Lost Yet
stories.poll_question: Should DOJ preemptively sue to block certification of a Senate race?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Challenging a flawed ballot system before results are locked in is legitimate.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Suing to void an election before votes are counted is authoritarian.

stories.title: Mandate or Meltdown? Cook Political Report Says GOP's House Majority Has 'All But Evaporated'
stories.conservative_headline: Beltway Forecasters Predict Blue Wave Again — Same Pundits Who Blew It in 2016, 2020 and 2024

stories.poll_question: Are the midterm forecasts showing a real Democratic wave?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Same forecasters have missed every Trump-era election; voters will surprise them.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Polling, retirements and approval numbers all point to a Democratic House.

stories.title: Worst of the Worst or Mostly Nobody? New Data Says Half of ICE Arrests Have No Criminal Record
stories.conservative_headline: ICE Removes Murderers, Traffickers and Gang Members as Deportations Hit Record Highs

stories.poll_question: Is ICE actually targeting dangerous criminals?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Illegal presence is illegal; priority cases include violent offenders being removed.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Most arrested have no charges, deep roots and American families.

stories.title: Trans Ideology or Basic Medicine? Supreme Court Blocks Trump's Transgender Prison Policy
stories.conservative_headline: Court Forces Taxpayers to Keep Funding Hormones and Surgeries for Federal Prisoners
stories.liberal_headline: Even This Supreme Court Won't Let Trump Strip Health Care From Trans Inmates
stories.poll_question: Should federal prisons provide gender-affirming care to inmates?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Prisoners shouldn't get elective transition treatment funded by the public.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Denying medically necessary care to inmates violates the Eighth Amendment.

stories.title: Fake News Purge or Press Eviction? Trump Floats Moving Reporters Out of the Briefing Room
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Shuts Down 'Swimming Pool' Hoax, Says He May Relocate the Obnoxious Press Corps
stories.liberal_headline: After Losing in Court Over Banning Three Outlets, Trump Muses About Evicting the Press
stories.poll_question: Can a president decide which reporters get White House access?
stories.poll_option1_desc: No outlet has a constitutional right to a West Wing seat.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Punishing outlets over coverage is unconstitutional retaliation, judges agree.

stories.title: Peace Breakthrough or PR Stunt? White House Says Melania Trump Brokered a Ukraine Ceasefire
stories.conservative_headline: First Lady Delivers Where Diplomats Failed: Ceasefire Secured for Besieged Ukrainian City

stories.poll_question: Is the Melania-brokered ceasefire a genuine diplomatic win?
stories.poll_option1_desc: A humanitarian ceasefire saves lives regardless of who negotiated it.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unverified claim designed to launder Trump's Russia policy before midterms.

stories.title: Back to Merit or War on Black Students? McMahon Blames DEI as Reading Scores Collapse
stories.conservative_headline: Education Secretary: Billions Wasted on DEI While Kids Graduated Unable to Read
stories.liberal_headline: McMahon Blames DEI for Illiteracy While Pushing Grant Money Toward 'Patriotic Education'
stories.poll_question: Did DEI programs hurt student achievement?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Schools chased ideology while reading and math scores fell nationwide.
stories.poll_option2_desc: DEI didn't cause illiteracy; underfunding and teacher shortages did.

stories.title: Price Relief or Premium Shock? Obamacare Rates Set to Jump Again as Open Enrollment Nears
stories.conservative_headline: Obamacare Was Always Unsustainable — Insurers Admit the Subsidy Sugar High Is Over

stories.poll_question: Who's responsible for soaring health insurance premiums?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Obamacare's design, not subsidy expiration, drives costs ever higher.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Republicans let enhanced tax credits lapse, doubling what families pay.

stories.title: Accountability or Payback? Two Ex-FBI Officials Charged Over Hunter Biden Laptop Statements

stories.poll_question: Are these indictments justice or retribution?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Officials who misled the public about the laptop must face consequences.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Prosecuting perceived enemies on thin charges corrupts federal law enforcement.

stories.title: Starlink Favor or Dangerous Leverage? Trump's Call to Musk Over Ukraine's Satellite Blackout

stories.liberal_headline: A Private Billionaire Throttled a War Zone's Internet, and Only Trump Could Flip It Back On
stories.poll_question: Should one company control battlefield internet access?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Musk built it; government shouldn't dictate how his network is used.
stories.poll_option2_desc: No billionaire should unilaterally decide an ally's wartime communications.
